# AI Agent Study Guide

> Learn to build AI coding agents by studying OpenAI Codex-RS architecture. This repository documents the TUI ↔ Agent communication patterns, event-driven architecture, and approval workflows used in production AI coding assistants.

## Documentation

- [Architecture Diagram](docs/architecture-diagram.md): Mermaid sequence diagrams showing TUI ↔ Core Agent communication flow, approval workflows, and state machine
- [Interactive Architecture](docs/codex-architecture.html): HTML page with expandable nodes, GitHub source links, and 5 rendered mermaid diagrams
- [Core Concepts](docs/CONCEPTS.md): Agent communication patterns, safety patterns, thread management, event-driven architecture
- [Glossary](docs/GLOSSARY.md): Definitions of key terms used in AI agent architecture
- [Implementation Patterns](docs/PATTERNS.md): Reusable patterns for building AI coding agents
- [AI Agent Workflows](docs/WORKFLOWS.md): Step-by-step workflows for AI agents working on this repository

## AI Tool Configurations

This repository includes configurations for multiple AI coding tools:
- Claude Code: CLAUDE.md, .claude/settings.json
- Cursor: .cursorrules, .cursor/rules/*.mdc
- Windsurf: .windsurfrules
- Aider: .aider.conf.yml
- Continue.dev: .continue/config.json
- GitHub Copilot: .github/copilot-instructions.md
- MCP Servers: .mcp.json
- Gitingest: .gitingest

## Key Concepts

### Architecture Layers
- TUI Layer: User interface, event handling, rendering (App, ChatWidget, ApprovalOverlay)
- Core Layer: Agent execution, thread lifecycle, LLM interaction (ThreadManager, CodexThread, Codex)
- Protocol Layer: Message types, operations, events (Op enum, EventMsg enum, Event struct)
- App Server: JSON-RPC for external clients like VS Code (MessageProcessor)

### Communication Pattern
TUI uses ThreadManager directly via submit(Op) and recv() on CodexThread. MessageProcessor is only for external JSON-RPC clients.

### Key Types
- Op: Operations submitted to agent (UserTurn, ExecApproval, Interrupt, ApplyPatchApproval, Undo, RunUserShellCommand)
- EventMsg: Events emitted by agent (TurnStarted, TurnComplete, ExecApprovalRequest, AgentMessage, ExecCommandBegin, ExecCommandEnd)
- Event: Wrapper struct with id (String) and msg (EventMsg)

- Core: https://github.com/openai/codex/tree/main/codex-rs/core
